hypotheses.justification: By definition, f.ker is the largest ideal sheaf contained componentwise in the section-map kernels. Since X is reduced, each such kernel is radical by Ideal.isRadical_bot.comap. Thus f.ideal_ker_le and Ideal.IsRadical.radical_le_iff show that f.ker.radical remains componentwise contained in those kernels. IdealSheafData.le_ofIdeals_iff then gives f.ker.radical ≤ f.ker; the reverse inequality is IdealSheafData.le_radical. This replaces ker_apply without requiring quasi-compactness and also covers empty schemes and trivial section rings.
